name: Atlas-MD
description: The future of WhatsApp bots now with plugin support.

PREFIX.description: Command prefix (default is /). Set PREFIX to override it.

SESSION_ID.description: A stable, unique id for this bot's WhatsApp session. Keep it unchanged to restore that session.

SESSION_DIR.description: Optional writable directory for the local Baileys auth working copy; MongoDB stores the durable session.

MODS.description: Put any phone number without + , () and spaces "," Ex: 9181xxxxxxxx,9298xxxxxxxx )

TENOR_API_KEY.description: A key used for gif searches. If you don't have any keet it default: AIzaSyCyouca1_KKy4W_MG1xsPzuku5oa8W358c

PACKNAME.description: Put a sticker packname here. Default is: Atlas Bot

MONGODB.description: Put Your MongoDB URL. You can create MongoDB Atlas URL for free.

PAIRING_API_TOKEN.description: Random secret of at least 32 characters for protected dashboard QR and pairing endpoints.

OPENAI_API.description: Put your OpenAI API key here if you want to use ChatGPT and DALL-E.
